# Dedicated physically scaled mineral textures; no whole-wall stretched swatch.
N=1024
def band_field(seed,frequency,anisotropy=1):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);raw=rng.standard_normal((N,N))
 fy,fx=np.meshgrid(np.fft.fftfreq(N),np.fft.fftfreq(N),indexing='ij')
 filt=np.exp(-((fx*N/frequency)**2+(fy*N/(frequency*anisotropy))**2)*.5)
 result=np.fft.ifft2(np.fft.fft2(raw)*filt).real
 return np.clip(result/max(result.std(),1e-8),-2.6,2.6)
def pores_field(seed,count,scale):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);field=np.zeros((N,N),np.float32)
 for i in range(count):
  rad=rng.uniform(.0007,.0028)*N/scale;cx=int(rng.integers(8,N-8));cy=int(rng.integers(8,N-8));r=max(2,int(rad*3))
  xa=max(0,cx-r);xb=min(N,cx+r+1);ya=max(0,cy-r);yb=min(N,cy+r+1)
  yy,xx=np.mgrid[ya:yb,xa:xb]
  field[ya:yb,xa:xb]+=rng.uniform(.4,1)*np.exp(-((xx-cx)**2+(yy-cy)**2)/(rad*rad))
 return np.clip(field,0,1)
mineral_materials={}

  else:
   sep=nodes.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor');links.new(tex.outputs['Color'],sep.inputs['Color']);links.new(sep.outputs['Green'],bs.inputs['Roughness'])
 mineral_materials[kind]=(mat,scale)
def physical_surface_uv(o,kind,variation=True):
 mat,scale=mineral_materials[kind];o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(mat)
 while o.data.uv_layers:o.data.uv_layers.remove(o.data.uv_layers[0])
 uv=o.data.uv_layers.new(name='PhysicalMineralUV')
 seed=sum((i+1)*ord(ch) for i,ch in enumerate(o.name))
 phase=Vector(((seed%109)/109,((seed*13)%127)/127)) if variation else Vector((.17,.31))
 for poly in o.data.polygons:
  n=(o.matrix_world.to_3x3()@poly.normal).normalized()
  tangent=Vector((0,1,0)) if abs(n.y)<.9 else Vector((1,0,0))
  tangent=(tangent-n*tangent.dot(n)).normalized();vertical=n.cross(tangent)
  for li in poly.loop_indices:
   p=o.matrix_world@o.data.vertices[o.data.loops[li].vertex_index].co
   uv.data[li].uv=(p.dot(tangent)/scale+phase.x,p.dot(vertical)/scale+phase.y)
